_comment: Unglazed fireclay: a refractory clay fired hot (firebricks, kiln furniture, the bare body of fireclay sinks), denser and paler than earthenware: a buff-cream body with coarse grog and dark iron specks, matte and porous. Opaque: a solid, rough dielectric. Base textures are generated (L2, tools/converters/base/gen_fireclay_natural.py) with their MEAN albedo anchored to a judgement, since Physically Based has no fireclay (its Clay is modelling clay, its Brick is red). Carries every relevant wear layer at 0 (C1): chipped edge wear (overlay 1, damage) and dust as a deposit (Phase10), gated by the Crevice mask (chips in broken patches, dust in the recesses). No third layer is relevant. Built by the Phase11 batch.
name: Fireclay_Natural_Clean_Base_s01_v01

sources.why: Mean linear albedo (0.60, 0.48, 0.31), about sRGB 205, 185, 150, for a buff unglazed fireclay body; roughness about 0.88 for a matte porous fired surface; specular_ior 1.5 as for Physically Based Clay and Brick, neither of which is a fireclay.
